chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Abdullah ibn Said narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Mansur ibn Abi al-Jahm and Abu Yazid al-Qurashi narrated to us. They said: Nasr ibn Ali al-Jahdami narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Jafar ibn Muhammad narrated to us. He said: My brother Musa ibn Jafar narrated to me, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them both). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) took the hands of al-Hasan and al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) and said: Whoever loves these two, their father, and their mother will be with me in my rank on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.أحب: Loves — sincere love (hubb) that encompasses devotion and following
key_terms.درجتي: My rank/station — refers to the highest rank in Paradise reserved for the Prophet
key_terms.يوم القيامة: Day of Resurrection — the eschatological day of final judgment

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about loving al-Hasan and al-Husayn?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Amali of al-Shaykh al-Saduq, Imam Ali (AS) reports that the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) took the hands of his grandsons al-Hasan and al-Husayn (AS) and declared that whoever loves them, their father Ali, and their mother Fatima will share his rank in the Hereafter. This hadith, transmitted through a distinguished chain going back through several Shia Imams, emphasizes the centrality of love for the Ahl al-Bayt in Islamic soteriology.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Hasan b. `Abdullah b. Sa`id narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Mansur b. Abi’l Jahm and Abu Yazid al-Qurashi narrated to us. They said: Nasr b. `Ali al-Jahdami narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ja`far b. Muhammad narrated to us. He said: My brother Musa b. Ja`far narrated to me from his father from his grandfather from `Ali b. Abi Talib (as).
The Messenger of Allah (s) took the hands of al-Hasan and al-Husayn (as) and said: Whoever loves these two, their father, and their mother will be with me in my rank on the Day of Resurrection.
